title: Improvements
description:
Improvements

- CLI and server fixes:
  - print work dir on start
  - switch using latest `jpillora/opts` 
  - should show command `client`(opts may about args and commands, this hsould be allowed, commands just take precedence, fix `../opts` if the case)
  - user can symlink `sshd-lite` to `ssh-lite` and we should detect the exec name, and this effectively prepends `client` is the first arg
  - when `--mosh` is enabled, it should print “Mosh enabled” and the “Listening on udp://… for mosh connections” and the other listening message should change say “Listening on tcp://… for ssh connections
  - move max pending handshakes to a `MAX_PENDING_HANDSHAKES` variable (use a `getEnvInt(key, defaultInt)`helper)
  - translate flag `--noenv` see in os.Args to `—-no-client-env` ; and rename the field to NoClientEnv (so we keep backwards compatibility)
  - add feature `--sftp-wd` with config value too, which “when enabled, restricts all SFTP commands to only operate inside the `--work-dir`"
- client fixes:
  - on known hosts mismatch, if Is-a-TTY, should warn loudly but offer to replace (Y/N)
  - on known hosts missing,  if Is-a-TTY, should warn softly but offer to add (Y/N); and add a new client flag `—-accept` which does Y automatically
  - on connect, it appears to `clear` the screen; normal ssh does not do this; fix it
  - when client connects to a sshd-lite server without `--mosh`, it hangs; it should get denied instead
